title: Inverse image to a geometric point is the stalk
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field and $P=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum].

1. The global-sections functor $\Gamma(P,-):\Ab(P_{\Et})\to\Ab$ on abelian sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] is an equivalence of categories; in particular it is exact. The same holds for $\Mod(P_{\Et},\Lambda)\to\Mod_\Lambda$ for every ring $\Lambda$.
2. Let $Y$ be a scheme and $\bar y:P\to Y$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. For every abelian sheaf $G$ on $Y_{\Et}$ there is an isomorphism $\Gamma(P,\bar y^{-1}G)\cong G_{\bar y}$, natural in $G$, between the global sections of the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and the stalk of $G$ at $\bar y$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks].

proof.text: For abelian sheaves, apply [lem-weil-pbc-spec-algebraically-closed-etale-sheaf-constant] to the underlying sheaf of sets. Mathlib constantSheafAdj_counit_w identifies the image of the abelian counit under sheafCompose(forget) with the set-valued counit up to a canonical isomorphism. The forgetful functor on sheaves reflects isomorphisms, so the abelian counit is invertible. This is globalSections_addCommGrp_isEquivalence in the Lean proof.

The already proved source-library instance Scheme.isLocalSite_smallEtaleTopology_of_isSepClosed (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.PointConstantSheaf) makes the constant-sheaf functor fully faithful, by Mathlib LocalSite. Hence the unit of the constant-sheaf/global-sections adjunction is invertible. Together with Step 1 this makes global sections an equivalence for abelian sheaves. Transport evaluation from the chosen terminal object to the identity etale object using their unique isomorphism. For every ring Lambda, use the already proved Scheme.isEquivalence_constantSheaf_of_isSepClosed in the same source module, and Adjunction.isEquivalence_right_of_isEquivalence_left, to obtain the module-valued global-sections equivalence. Equivalences preserve all limits and colimits, in particular finite ones. These source-library declarations are fully proved tools, not additional open obligations.

proof.text: For the identity point of P=Spec Omega, the set-valued germ is bijective by [lem-weil-pbc-spec-algebraically-closed-etale-sheaf-constant]. The forgetful functor from abelian groups preserves the filtered stalk colimit (shrink its universe to u). Point.toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberCompIso_hom_app identifies the forgotten abelian germ with the set-valued germ followed by the canonical colimit comparison isomorphism. Reflection of isomorphisms by forget therefore makes the abelian germ invertible. Its natural transformation is the restriction of Point.toPresheafFiberNatTrans to sheaves; taking asIso yields the natural isomorphism from global sections to the identity-point stalk.
